headline: Motilal Oswal recommends buying 360 ONE WAM with a Rs 1400 target
summary: Motilal Oswal has issued a buy call on 360 ONE WAM, setting a target price of Rs 1400 per share. The brokerage believes the stock is undervalued and could appreciate further. The recommendation is aimed at investors looking for exposure to the company. Retail investors may consider the target when assessing the stock’s upside.

headline: 360 ONE reports Q2 FY27 profit decline amid rising recurring revenue
hook: Recurring revenue climbs despite lower quarterly profits
summary: 360 ONE Wealth reported a decline in net profit for the second quarter of FY27, even as its Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth accelerated. The firm saw increased traction in its wealth management and asset management segments during the period. Despite the bottom-line pressure, the company maintained its focus on scaling its recurring income streams. The results reflect the ongoing shift in the company's revenue mix toward more stable, fee-based income.
why_it_matters: Wealth management fee stability signals long-term operational health for shareholders.

headline: 360 ONE submits monitoring agency report for preferential issue of warrants
hook: Routine quarterly compliance filed by 360 ONE
summary: 360 ONE WAM has submitted the monitoring agency report issued by CARE Ratings Limited for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The report covers the utilization of funds raised through preferential issues of warrants. Such procedural filings are mandatory under SEBI regulations for companies that raise capital through preferential routes. Indian retail investors holding the stock can review the utilization of preferential issue proceeds for transparency.
why_it_matters: Confirms fund utilization transparency for 360 ONE warrant holders

headline: 360 ONE WAM posts 14 percent higher Q2 total income and declares Rs 7.50 per share dividend
hook: Steady growth and another payout from wealth manager
summary: 360 ONE WAM reported a 14 percent increase in total income for the second quarter. The company's board approved an interim dividend of Rs 7.50 per share. Wealth management firms like 360 ONE WAM benefit from rising domestic financial assets and affluent investor counts. Indian retail investors holding the stock receive regular cash payouts alongside revenue expansion.
why_it_matters: Quarterly income growth and dividend payout confirmed for shareholders.

headline: 360 ONE WAM reports Q2 AUM at nearly ₹9 lakh crore alongside a dividend
hook: Wealth assets drive a 31% AUM expansion
summary: 360 ONE WAM reported its Assets Under Management grew 31% year-on-year to ₹8.99 lakh crore for the second quarter. Wealth management AUM expanded by 34%, while asset management AUM grew by 14%. The firm also declared a dividend for its shareholders. This performance reflects steady growth in fee-generating assets for the wealth manager.
why_it_matters: Strong asset growth supports fee income for shareholders

headline: 360 One Wam sets record date for dividend
summary: 360 One Wam Limited has announced October 23, 2026, as the record date for an upcoming dividend. Shareholders holding the company's shares as of this date will be eligible for the payout. Routine corporate actions like this determine dividend eligibility for registered investors. Retail investors holding the stock should verify their demat account status ahead of the record date.
why_it_matters: Eligibility locked for upcoming dividend payout

headline: 360 One Wam submits investor presentation to the exchange
hook: Routine investor deck released by 360 ONE
summary: 360 One Wam Limited has submitted its latest investor presentation to the stock exchanges. Such filings provide insights into the company's operational performance, strategic direction, and financial health. Retail investors can review the presentation to track management guidance and business segment updates. The disclosure carries standard corporate information without immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine strategy update for existing shareholders.

headline: 360 One Wam declares an interim dividend of Rs 7.50 per share
hook: Third payout this fiscal year for holders
summary: The board of directors of 360 One Wam Limited approved an interim dividend of Rs 7.50 per equity share during their meeting on October 15, 2026. This payout rewards existing shareholders with regular cash returns from the company's earnings. Indian retail investors holding the stock as of the record date will receive this dividend directly. Dividend payouts provide steady income for retail investors apart from capital appreciation.
whats_next: Record date and payment date for the interim dividend
why_it_matters: Cash payout credited directly to your bank account

headline: Sensex expiry day features 25 key corporate results
summary: The Indian markets face a busy session on October 15 as 25 major companies report their quarterly earnings alongside the Sensex expiry. Key firms releasing results include HDFC Life, Jio Financial Services, Nestle India, Persistent Systems, and Polycab. The index is currently struggling to maintain momentum amid this heavy corporate reporting schedule. Retail investors should prepare for increased volatility across the financial, consumer, and IT sectors.
whats_next: October 15, 2024: Earnings announcements and Sensex expiry
why_it_matters: High volatility expected as multiple sector leaders announce quarterly performance.

headline: Paras Healthcare to launch Rs 1,450-crore IPO on October 21
summary: Paras Healthcare, backed by private equity firms Creador and 360 ONE, is set to launch its initial public offering worth Rs 1,450 crore on October 21. The hospital chain operates primarily in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities in northern and eastern India. Retail investors will have a new healthcare sector stock option to evaluate upon the issue opening.
whats_next: IPO opens for subscription on October 21
why_it_matters: New hospital chain IPO opens for subscription on October 21.

headline: 360 One Wam gets ESG score of 79 from SEBI-registered rater
hook: High sustainability rating for 360 One Wam
summary: 360 One Wam has been assigned an environmental, social, and governance score of 79 by a SEBI-registered rating agency. ESG scores reflect a company's performance across sustainability, labor practices, and corporate governance metrics. For Indian retail investors, high governance and sustainability ratings can sometimes influence institutional fund allocations into the stock. The score offers an independent benchmark of the wealth management firm's non-financial operating standards.
why_it_matters: Higher ESG ratings may attract increased institutional fund flows over time.
